player_0.content: I got stuck in a loop between the Pantry, Bar, and Solarium, repeatedly visiting the same rooms without exploring the rest of the map. I failed to track which rooms I had already visited, causing me to return to the Pantry and incorrectly assume I had completed the task. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. When I enter a room I have already been to, I will immediately check my list for unvisited neighbors and prioritize moving to a new room rather than returning to a previous one. I will only issue "DONE" when I am certain all reachable rooms have been visited.
